mappings.assessment: Matches. The target's NormalRing quantifies over every ideal with IsPrime evidence and requires NormalDomain of its prime localization. NormalDomain extends IsDomain and IsIntegrallyClosed. Prime localization is localization at the prime complement; for domains FractionRing is a field.

Matches despite the abbreviated name. IsIntegrallyClosed R uses FractionRing R, which is localization at nonZeroDivisors R, so it does not secretly require R to be a domain. Its expanded condition says every integral fraction lies in the image of R; the fraction map is injective.

Matches: existential finite index type, commutative ring structures and normal-domain properties for every factor, plus existence of a ring isomorphism to the dependent function product. The index type may be empty, consistently accommodating the zero ring. List.TFAE asserts pairwise logical equivalence of all three propositions, preserving all directions.
